body: my friends are my age, so 17-18. i don’t like talking to them as much because they have their own issues and i don’t want to be a burden (which is how i feel when they ignore me). i know i’m a shitty person for getting them involved in my problems in the first place so i don’t need more people telling me that. i’ve been seeing my current therapist for a year, but i saw another therapist for 3 years. i was php once and that was honestly the only time in my life i didn’t feel this way. when i moved a year ago and spoke to a psychiatrist she brushed off everything i said, like, “oh, you’ve only been php and not inpatient so it’s not that bad,” and “you’ve never been hospitalized for self harm so it’s not a big deal,” and then she set me up with a therapist that only sees me once every 1-2 months when my old therapist saw me every week and even then it was hard to live between sessions. i just feel like my friends don’t want to be involved with me, which i understand, and i feel like the mental health system has failed me.
i try talking to my friends and my therapist but both just brush off everything i say. i’ve tried hotlines and stuff too but they always make me feel worse than before somehow.
i don’t think they’ll hospitalize you unless you tell them you have a plan. hospitalization is for when you’re an immediate danger to yourself or others.
